items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Expanding sections that grow to their natural height with no measuring, with arrow key navigation and closed panels skipped by Tab.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Banner with a colored accent stripe. Body text stays neutral so contrast never depends on the variant.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Round avatar whose image fades in on load and crossfades to initials if it fails.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Small status pill in five colors, with a crossfade for when its variant changes.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Button with a quick press, hairline rings instead of borders, four variants, and a 44px tap area even at small sizes.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Bordered surface with header, content, and footer parts for grouping related content.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Checkbox on a real checkbox input, with a check mark that pops in rather than just appearing.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command Palette
items.description: Command-K style search overlay that filters as you type, with arrow keys to move the highlight and Enter to select.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy Button
items.description: Copies text to the clipboard and trades its icon for a check for a moment, with a label or as a single icon.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: diff-view
items.title: Diff View
items.description: A line-by-line diff with an added or removed mark in the gutter and a tinted row for each side. Renders a diff, doesn't compute one.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: Sheet that slides up from the bottom edge on the native dialog element. Drag the handle down, or flick it, to dismiss.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Action menu that opens from a trigger, flips upward when there is no room below, and supports a destructive item.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: dynamic-island
items.title: Dynamic Island
items.description: A pill that morphs between a compact status line and any number of named live-activity views, the same element reshaping via layout animation each time.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: expandable-tabs
items.title: Expandable Tabs
items.description: A row of icon tabs where the selected one expands to reveal its label, sliding a shared background pill to match.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: file-upload
items.title: File Upload
items.description: Dropzone that also opens the native file picker, with a list below it that pops each file in and collapses smoothly on remove.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: gradient-text
items.title: Gradient Text
items.description: Text filled with a slowly drifting rainbow. It pauses while off screen and holds still when reduced motion is on.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: hold-to-confirm
items.title: Hold to Confirm
items.description: Button for destructive actions that fills while you hold it and only fires once the fill completes. Letting go early drains it back quickly.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Text input whose focus ring grows from a hairline to two px, with a destructive ring for aria-invalid.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: insight-card
items.title: Insight Card
items.description: A stat tile: a label, a headline value, and an optional trend pill. Pass a Number Ticker as the value to have it roll in on change.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: modal
items.title: Modal
items.description: Centered dialog on the native dialog element that fades and scales in, leaves faster than it arrives, and keeps focus inside while open.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: morphing-search
items.title: Morphing Search
items.description: A circular search button that morphs into a text field: the same element grows and reshapes via a layout animation, rather than a new one popping in beside it.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: notification-stack
items.title: Notification Stack
items.description: A deck of notification cards: collapsed to the top card with peeking edges behind it, fanning into a readable list on hover or focus.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: number-ticker
items.title: Number Ticker
items.description: Number that rolls to a new value like an odometer, one changed digit at a time.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP Input
items.description: One box per digit for a verification code, with paste and SMS autofill support and a shake for a wrong code.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A panel of arbitrary content anchored to a trigger, opening on click and flipping above it when there's no room below.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Progress bar that fills with scale instead of width, plus an indeterminate state for unknown durations.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: pull-to-refresh
items.title: Pull to Refresh
items.description: A pull-down gesture over scrollable content: the indicator tracks the finger 1:1, then resists past the trigger distance and spins while refreshing.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: range-slider
items.title: Range Slider
items.description: Native range input with a filled track and tick dots, so keyboard and screen reader support come built in.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Composable select whose menu fades and scales out of the trigger, and opens upward when there is no room below.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: selection-actions
items.title: Selection Actions
items.description: A floating bar of bulk actions that fades and rises in once a selection leaves zero, for pairing with Table or any selectable list.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Loading placeholder with one shimmer shared across the page. Wrap real content and it takes the same shape, then crossfades away.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: On and off switch with a quick slide and no bounce. Inside a label, the whole row is the tap target.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: A plain, composable data table: sortable headers with an arrow that only shows on hover until active, and rows that tint when selected.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Pill, segment, or underline tabs with an indicator that slides to the selected tab.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: text-animation
items.title: Text Animation
items.description: One component, three ways to animate text: a scramble that resolves into place, a word or character reveal out of a blur, and a loading shimmer sweep.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Textarea that grows with its content instead of scrolling, down to three rows and up to a scrollable cap.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: Theme Toggle
items.description: Light and dark switch that reveals the new theme as a circle growing from the center of the screen or from the button itself.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Toasts that stay long enough to read based on their word count, and pause while hovered or while the tab is in the background.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Tooltip that shows a label with its keyboard shortcut, using Command on Mac and Ctrl elsewhere. Moving along a toolbar crossfades to the next tooltip with no delay.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: agent-loading-states
items.title: Agent Loading States
items.description: Three loading states for AI interfaces: shimmering status text, live agent progress, and cycling reasoning phrases.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: A code block with a label, a copy button, and light coloring for keywords, strings, comments and numbers, with no highlighter dependency.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: flowchart
items.title: Flowchart
items.description: A sequence of steps on a dotted canvas, connected by curves that measure the actual cards and follow as you drag one. Click a step to light up its connectors, or edit an if/else step's chips with real dropdowns.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: message-bubble
items.title: Message Bubble
items.description: A focused conversational surface with visual tones, independent alignment, and a speech-bubble tail that pops in on arrival.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: pixel-loader
items.title: Pixel Loader
items.description: A 3x3 grid of cells that twinkle on independent, randomized cycles, paired with a shimmering label and an optional live elapsed timer.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: prompt-input
items.title: Prompt Input
items.description: A chat composer that grows with its content, submits on Enter, and crossfades its send button into a stop button while a reply streams.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: streaming-response
items.title: Streaming Response
items.description: Wraps a response with the actions people expect once it settles: copy, replay, share, a thumbs up or down, and a list of suggested follow-up prompts. No card or border, so the answer reads as part of the page.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: streaming-text
items.title: Streaming Text
items.description: Reveals a model response as it streams in, fading each newly arrived word in on its own without replaying what's already on screen.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: todo-list
items.title: Todo List
items.description: A collapsible agent task plan with morphing status marks and a completion count.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: tool-approval
items.title: Tool Approval
items.description: A card for an agent action waiting on approval, with Approve and Deny that collapse into a single status pill once resolved.
items.author: Ryan

items.name: tool-chip
items.title: Tool Chip
items.description: A small pill naming a tool an agent used, with a spinner, check, or error mark that crossfades in place as its status changes.
items.author: Ryan
